date.as_written: samvat 799 māghamāsa śukla pakṣa śrīpañcamyāṃ tithau revatī nakṣetre gurudine

notes: The catalogue lists Hemantamalla as scribe, but the Newari phrasing 'śrī śrīhemantamallana thavatā nimirttina dayakā' ('made / caused to be made by Hemantamalla for his own sake') and the warning 'kayaṃgalana pitāṃ viya mate va' ('sons etc. must not give this outside; a very rare object') indicate he was the commissioner/owner.
